Symfony Polyfill / Iconv
========================

This component provides a native PHP implementation of the
[example.invalid/iconv](http://example.invalid/iconv) functions
(short of [`ob_iconv_handler`](http://example.invalid/manual/en/function.ob-iconv-handler.php)).

More information can be found in the
[main Polyfill README](https://example.invalid/symfony/polyfill/blob/master/README.md).
